세계 2차대전 막바지, 한국광복군은 조국을 되찾기 위한 8월 18일 조국:
At the end of World War II, the Korean Liberation Army planned an operation to retake the homeland on August 18.
But Japan surrendered unconditionally on August 15, and liberation came before Korea could show the world its own strength.

You are sent to a Gyeongseong in a world where the Korean Liberation Army, the Korean Volunteer Corps and the city's Righteous Army
have resolved to carry out the August 18 operation.
Become a secret agent and wage an intelligence war against imperial Japan.
Join forces with comrades who share the dream of liberation and bring down Japan's command in the city.
The fate of the homeland is in your hands.
한국광복군과 조선의용대는 민족연합군을 세우고, 서울진공작전으로 경성의 일:
The Korean Liberation Army and the Korean Volunteer Corps have formed a united national army and plan to topple the Japanese command in Gyeongseong.
You are dispatched to the city as its agents. Carry out your mission.
요원들이 애썼지만 일제에 큰 타격을 주지 못했습니다.\n일본은 미국의 원:
The agents fought hard but could not deal Japan a heavy blow.
Japan surrendered unconditionally after the American atomic bombings.

But do not lose heart.
Without the agents' struggle, the nation's history and spirit would have been crushed under Japanese oppression,
and today's Republic of Korea might never have existed.
요원들의 첩보 활동 덕분에 조국 탈환작전이 예상보다 수월하게 실행되었습니:
Thanks to the agents' intelligence work, the operation went more smoothly than expected.
The Liberation Army, the Volunteer Corps and the Righteous Army crushed the Japanese command in the city
and, as proud members of the Allies, showed the world the spirit of the Korean people.
요원들의 첩보 활동으로 탈환작전을 예상보다 4일이나 앞당겨 실행할 수 있:
The agents' work let the operation begin four days ahead of schedule.
Our united independence army crushed every Japanese force in the city on its own.
We won our independence with our own hands.
Roll the dice, then click a gold square or use the arrow keys (WASD). Space: roll / end move.
Each round is one day. Reach the Liberation goal before Japan surrenders on August 15.
The alert rises as days pass and the police get faster. Checkpoints need an evade roll to pass.
The Pacific War was drawing to a close.
한국광복군은 미국 OSS와 손잡고 국내 진공을 준비했다.\n조국 탈환작전:
The Korean Liberation Army joined hands with the American OSS to prepare an advance into Korea.
The day of the operation: August 18.
그러나 일본은 사흘 먼저 무조건 항복했다.\n우리 손으로 되찾지 못한 광:
But Japan surrendered unconditionally three days earlier.
Liberation came — but not by our own hands.
작전이 조금만 더 빨랐다면?: the operation had come just a little sooner?
한국광복군, 조선의용대, 그리고 경성의 의병이 하나로 뭉쳤다.\n일본이:
The Liberation Army, the Volunteer Corps and the city's Righteous Army stand as one.
Before Japan surrenders, we will win liberation ourselves.
the fate of the homeland is in your hands.
튜토리얼에 오신 것을 환영합니다.\n\n당신은 한국광복군 요원입니다. 조:
Welcome to the tutorial.

You are an agent of the Korean Liberation Army. With one comrade from the Korean Volunteer Corps, reach 3 Liberation before August 15.

We'll guide you step by step.
당신의 차례입니다. 먼저 [주사위 굴리기]를 누르세요 (스페이스도 됩니다:
It's your turn. First press [Roll dice] (Space works too).

You can move as many squares as you roll.
금색 점선 칸이 지금 갈 수 있는 곳입니다. 칸을 누르면 한 칸 이동합니:
Squares with a gold dashed border are where you can go now. Click one to move a step.

'?' squares are unexplored streets. Entering one reveals a new tile.
Hover a far square to see a route; click it to walk there.
새 타일이 깔렸습니다!\n\n· 이벤트(빨강)·아이템(파랑) 타일: 그:
A new tile appeared!

· Event (red) and item (blue) tiles: stop on them to draw a card.
· Mission tiles (black = assassination, etc.): with the matching mission, you act the moment you enter.
· Checkpoints: you need an evade roll to enter.
카드를 뽑았습니다. 아이템은 오른쪽 '내 손패'에 카드로 들어갑니다.\n:
You drew a card. Items go to 'My hand' on the right.

Lasting items work just by holding them; cards glowing gold can be clicked to use. Hover a card for details.
붉은 '목표' 깃발이 보이나요? 지금 미션(암살)을 수행할 수 있는 곳입:
See the red 'Target' flag? That's where you can carry out your mission (assassination).

Enter that square to roll. Your spyglass gives +1.
판정은 주사위 2개의 합으로 합니다. 판정 전에 목표값과 성공 확률이 표:
Rolls use the sum of two dice. The target number and your chance are shown first.

Liberation Army agents always evade, so even a failed assassination won't get you caught.
일본 경찰이 당신을 쫓기 시작했습니다!\n\n경찰은 다음 차례부터 움직입:
The Japanese police are after you!

They start moving next turn. Red hatching shows where they can reach at the end of this turn. Run beyond it. Get more than 3 squares away to lose them.
Liberation went up! Fill every box of the Liberation gauge at the top to win.

Finishing a mission gives you a new one. Check your new target.
하루가 지났습니다. 위쪽 달력에서 하루가 지워졌습니다. 순사 모자로 표시:
A day has passed and it's crossed off the calendar at the top. As the 'alert level' (shown with police caps) rises, the police get faster.

Every morning an 'Occupation Orders' card is revealed — new checkpoints may appear or raids may begin.
세력 능력은 하루에 한 번 쓸 수 있습니다.\n\n광복군의 [무전 지원]:
Faction abilities can be used once per day.

The Liberation Army's [Radio Support] gives a comrade +1 move next turn. Try the [Radio Support] button at the bottom right.
요원이 감옥에 갇혔습니다. 갇힌 요원은 탈옥 판정만 할 수 있습니다.\n:
An agent has been jailed. Jailed agents can only roll to escape.

Another agent entering that stronghold frees them at once. Look for the blue 'Rescue' flag.
튜토리얼 완료! 이제 실제 작전에 나설 준비가 되었습니다.\n\n본 작전:
Tutorial complete! You're ready for a real operation.

Real operations have more comrades and a higher goal of 10. Good luck.
8월 15일 일본이 항복하기 전에 동지들과 힘을 합쳐 광복수치를 목표치(: Work with your comrades to raise Liberation to the goal (usually 10) before Japan surrenders on August 15. One round (everyone takes a turn) is one day.
① 주사위를 굴려 나온 만큼 이동합니다 (대각선 불가, 중간에 멈출 수:
① Roll and move up to that many squares (no diagonals; you may stop early).
② Moving into an empty square reveals a new tile.
③ You get the effect of the square you stop on (event, item, supply).
④ At the end of your turn, the police chasing you move.
At the start of your turn you may swap your mission instead, but that ends your turn.
· 암살: 암살미션 타일에서 판정 9 이상 → 광복 +2. 실패하면 회피:
· Assassination: roll 9+ on an assassination tile → Liberation +2. On failure roll to evade; fail that too and you're jailed.
· Intel Theft: enter the named stronghold → Liberation +1.
· Demolition: get a bomb at a supply tile, then reach a demolition tile → Liberation +1.
· Disruption: roll 7+ to evade on a disruption tile → Liberation +1.
Carrying out missions or getting spotted at strongholds and checkpoints brings police after that agent. Police start moving the next turn; if they catch you, you're jailed at the nearest stronghold. Get more than 3 squares away to lose them.
In prison you can only roll to escape (9+), or be rescued when a comrade enters that stronghold.
작전 기간을 셋으로 나눠 날짜가 지날수록 경계 1→2→3단계가 되고, 경: The operation is split into thirds: as days pass the alert goes 1→2→3 and police move 2→3→4 squares. An Occupation Orders card is revealed every morning.
· 아이템 건네기: 옆 칸의 동료에게 아이템을 줍니다.\n· 미끼: 근처:
· Give item: hand an item to an adjacent comrade.
· Decoy: draw the police chasing a nearby comrade toward you.

This game is a fictional story based on historical facts.
1940년 9월 중국 충칭에서 창설된 대한민국 임시정부의 군대입니다. 1: The army of the Korean Provisional Government, founded in Chongqing, China in September 1940. In 1945 it trained with the American OSS for an advance into Korea (the Eagle Project), but Japan's surrender on August 15 meant the operation never happened.
광복 사흘 뒤, 광복군 국내정진대(이범석, 김준엽, 장준하, 노능서)가: Three days after liberation, a Liberation Army advance team (Lee Beom-seok, Kim Jun-yeop, Jang Jun-ha, No Neung-seo) landed at Yeouido airfield with American troops. Blocked by still-armed Japanese forces, they had to fly back the next day.
An armed unit founded in Wuhan, China in October 1938 under Kim Won-bong. In 1942 part of it joined the Korean Liberation Army, while members who went to northern China became the Korean Volunteer Army and fought on.
대한제국 말기 일제의 침략에 맞서 일어난 민간 무장 투쟁입니다. 1910: Civilian armed resistance that rose against Japanese aggression in the last years of the Korean Empire. After the 1910 annexation many fighters moved to Manchuria and the Russian Maritime Province, becoming the roots of the independence armies. The '1945 Righteous Army in Gyeongseong' in this game is fictional.

대한민국 임시정부 주석: President of the Korean Provisional Government
1940년부터 임시정부 주석으로 광복군 창설을 이끌었습니다. 1932년: As president of the Provisional Government from 1940, he led the founding of the Liberation Army. He also headed the Korean Patriotic Organization, which directed the 1932 attacks by Lee Bong-chang and Yun Bong-gil.
Commander-in-chief of the Korean Liberation Army, founded in Chongqing in 1940.
미국 전략첩보국(OSS)과 함께 국내 진공 훈련을 이끌었고, 광복 직후: Led training with the American OSS for an advance into Korea, and right after liberation led the advance team that landed at Yeouido airfield.
일본군 학병에서 탈출해 광복군에 합류했고, OSS 훈련을 받은 뒤 국내정: Escaped from forced service as a student soldier in the Japanese army, joined the Liberation Army, trained with the OSS and came to Gyeongseong with the advance team.
조선의용대 창설자: Founder of the Korean Volunteer Corps
1919년 의열단을 조직했고, 1938년 조선의용대를 창설했습니다. 19: Organized the Heroic Corps (Uiyeoldan) in 1919 and founded the Korean Volunteer Corps in 1938. In 1942 he became deputy commander of the Korean Liberation Army.
의열단 창단 단원으로, 조선의용대에서 활동하다 1942년 태항산 전투에서: A founding member of the Heroic Corps who served in the Korean Volunteer Corps and was killed in the battle of the Taihang Mountains in 1942.
의병장 · 독립군 사령관: Righteous Army leader · independence army commander
대한제국 말기 의병장으로 이름을 떨쳤고, 1920년 봉오동 전투에서 독립: A renowned Righteous Army leader in the last years of the Korean Empire, he led independence forces to victory at the Battle of Fengwudong in 1920.
1906년 경상도에서 의병을 일으킨 평민 출신 의병장으로, 태백산 일대에: A commoner who raised a Righteous Army in Gyeongsang Province in 1906 and fought widely around the Taebaek Mountains.
